scope.theory: strict linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity
scope.frequency_scope: each separately certified rational child cell

current.required_endpoint_crosscheck: the +i convention must agree by congruence with the exact action-derived endpoint Gram; conservation alone is insufficient

connection.basis_changes: H'=H*AH, Bpm'=Bpm*Apm with AH,Apm in GL(3,C)

one_sided_relation.condition: Cminus is uniformly invertible on the complete cell
one_sided_relation.forbidden_name: full or canonically normalized scattering matrix

index_pullback.proof: If the populated endpoint image has dimension r, its intersection with the two-dimensional negative subspace has dimension at least r-1 by the dimension inequality; equivalently a nonnegative subspace has dimension at most one.
index_pullback.wavepacket_corollary: On any certified open frequency cell where the endpoint Gram and normalized connection are continuous, rank_Cplus>=2 supplies a local continuous negative direction; multiplying it by a nonzero compactly supported frequency profile gives strictly negative endpoint flux.
index_pullback.infinite_dimensional_refinement: Choose countably many nonzero compactly supported profiles with pairwise disjoint frequency supports inside the certified open cell. Frequency-diagonality makes their cross pairings zero, while each diagonal endpoint flux is negative, so their span is an infinite-dimensional negative endpoint-flux subspace.
index_pullback.claim_boundary: This is endpoint flux only. The horizon contribution remains separate, so it establishes neither negative total conserved energy nor a physical quantum ghost.
